purpose: Design-only orchestration catalog for Creative Craft Phase 2. It does not replace vfom, Creative Director, domain authorities, the shared CreativeCraftRouter, Media Vault, approval, or publishing.
invariants: vfom/velvet-creative-director owns public creative intent, Product Truth, brand, copy, Visual OS and review evidence
domain engineering/fabrication authorities own physical and engineering truth
craft skills own professional method and QA guidance, not business or publish authority
execution uses only currently accepted typed/bounded adapters and current routing state
no arbitrary script surface, no silent cloud/paid fallback, no automatic publishing
preserve pre-existing user sessions and stop only agent-owned GUI sessions
every cross-tool handoff is file-backed and hash-addressed; a render receipt is not publish authorization
no second Media Vault, Visual Foundry, creative approval queue, or orchestrator runtime

tool_choice_rules.manim_vs_motion: Use Manim for semantic geometry, measurement, process and technical-diagram animation. Use After Effects for art-directed layer/motion-graphics work. Use HyperFrames for deterministic template/social composition. Use Fusion Studio for dedicated node/VFX comps and Resolve Fusion for comps tightly coupled to a Resolve timeline.
tool_choice_rules.fusion_standalone_vs_resolve: Prefer standalone Fusion for reusable or batch-oriented node graphs independent of an edit timeline; prefer Resolve Fusion for shot/timeline-local compositing; neither replaces HyperFrames template rendering or Manim technical semantics.
tool_choice_rules.topaz_video: Use only when restoration/upscale/denoise/interpolation is justified. Source repair belongs before edit; final upscale belongs after picture lock. Always compare against source/master for invented detail or artifacts.
tool_choice_rules.media_encoder: Use as the Adobe final derivative factory only for named accepted presets. Current accepted preset is h264-high. Do not expose arbitrary encoder parameters. Use ffprobe for deterministic verification.
tool_choice_rules.voicestudio: Script/copy authority comes first. TTS/ASR then produces file-backed audio/transcript/timing plus back-transcription QA. Speech receipts never grant publication authorization.
